title: NightWatch Credential Reference
description: Reference-only credential descriptor (§13.1, §13.1.1). Contains ONLY: reference name, provider type, whether configured, optional scope, optional expiry. NO VALUE FIELDS — any value-bearing property is rejected by additionalProperties:false. The model context sees variable names and configured-ness only, never values.
x-nightwatch-security: No value fields allowed under any circumstances (§13.1).

configured.description: Whether the credential is currently configured in the provider.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry for the configured state.
